        properties: {
          limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3, description: 'Number of records per page (1..3).' },
          cursor: { type: 'string', description: 'Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous page.' }

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'audit_page') {
    throw toError(-32601, `Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  // validate no extra fields
  const allowed = new Set(['limit', 'cursor']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw toError(-32602, `Unknown argument: ${key}`);

    throw toError(-32602, 'limit must be an integer between 1 and 3');
  }
  // validate / parse cursor
  let page = 0;

    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw toError(-32602, 'cursor must be a string');
    }
    const m = args.cursor.match(CURSOR_RE);
